task.name: open_drawer_put_marker
task.description: Use the left arm to open the drawer, then use the right arm to put the marker inside.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the drawer handle.
2. Grasp the drawer handle with the left arm.
3. Pull the drawer open using the left arm.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the marker.
5. Grasp the marker with the right arm.
6. Move the right arm to align with the open drawer.
7. Release the gripper to place the marker inside the drawer.
